title: Oven-Roasted Middle Eastern Buttermilk Harees
description: A refreshing, spring-inspired Middle Eastern harees dish made with buttermilk, fragrant spices, and herbs, perfect for a light meal after a monsoon shower. The dairy-free-friendly mantecare emulsion adds a rich and creamy texture.
instructions: Combine buttermilk, mantecare emulsion, salt, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and black pepper in a large bowl. Whisk until smooth.
Add chopped parsley, dill, lemon juice, and olive oil to the bowl. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and roast at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.
Garnish with additional parsley and dill, if desired.
Serve warm, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh herbs.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
Reheat individual servings in the microwave or oven before serving.
This dish can be made in a large batch and refrigerated or frozen for later use.
